english.title: Proprietor of hackney carriage or PHV failing to notify transfer of interest in said vehicle - outside Greater London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the proprietor of

(A)_[a hackney carriage,]_
(B)_[a private hire vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in respect of which a vehicle licence has been granted by **(..SPECIFY THE DISTRICT COUNCIL..), transferred your interest in the vehicle to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), whose name was not specified in the licence and failed without reasonable excuse to give notice in writing of that transfer to the district council within fourteen days specifying the name and address of the person to whom the vehicle had been transferred
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 49 and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
